concerns.text: FR-002 mandates computing segregation energies using 'Quantum ESPRESSO DFT code'. Task T013 implements a 'surrogate model' and explicitly forbids DFT code. No task exists to implement the required DFT workflow or to formally document the substitution as a spec deviation in the task list itself, leaving the FR-002 requirement unaddressed in the implementation plan.

SC-003 requires validating computed energies against experimental literature (APT). Task T045d (fetch real data) is marked as a hard failure point with no fallback. If T045d fails, T060 (SC-003 execution) cannot run. There is no task to handle the 'missing data' scenario defined in the spec's edge cases or to provide a synthetic/placeholder validation path to satisfy the SC-003 measurement requirement.

FR-001 requires extracting compositions from 'provided CALPHAD database files' (TCFE9). The plan substitutes an 'Open Proxy'. Tasks T047a/b/c handle the proxy but lack a specific task to verify the proxy's coverage for the 5 specific ternary systems (Fe-Cr-Mo, etc.) against the FR-001 scope before execution, risking a silent failure on missing ternary parameters.

Task T071 references 'T072' for variance/detection limits, but T072 (Define detection limit) is listed as a dependency of T071 in the text description, yet T072 is defined *after* T071 in the task list order. While the dependency graph at the bottom clarifies the order, the task list itself presents a circular or out-of-order reference that could confuse the implementer.
